sources.sourceReview: Source-only AI review inspected all 184 selected original images in eight contact sheets, then unannotated enlarged crops around both disappearance/return boundaries, before any fresh prediction. Cat1 crosses behind a pole and stone wall: definite full obstruction at source603-607, with visible fragments at596,601-602 and608-609 kept uncertain because external target rectangles are absent. Cat2 is covered by a moving dog: definite full obstruction145-151, uncertain boundary144/152, then partial return. Group1 is an unobstructed aerial walking-person control throughout1-96; neighboring people are visible but have no independently supplied distractor boxes. Cat1 return remains partly hidden by the wall/vegetation; cat2 overlap remains partial through163. These are separate AI visibility judgments added to external benchmark geometry, not independent human adjudication or semantic identity proof. No recorded target is out of view in the selected windows. Any external box below the unchanged measurable minimum becomes unscorable. No tracker output was used to choose these labels.

priorImageOverlap.scope: Exact JPEG hashes against retained publication JSON image hashes; not proof against different encodings.

limitations: Bounded windows, not a full VOT benchmark or live camera validation.
External rectangles plus separately attributed AI source-only visibility; no independent human review.
No labelled distractor geometry, so zero labelled-other matches cannot establish switch-free identity.
